key_insight: Metadata-Driven AI uses only metadata to generate reusable analysis programs, keeping actual data away from the LLM and avoiding inference costs on repeat runs.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic site prospection, this architecture supports analysis over live public APIs while separating LLM code generation from data-local execution.
method: Send metadata, not actual data, across a one-way inference boundary to the LLM.
Execute the generated analysis program next to the data.
Retain the program for reuse without repeated LLM inference.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cost model, metadata-transfer measurements on public datasets, a small locally hosted model benchmark, and three application examples, including photovoltaic prospection.
watch_item: Generated programs still need correctness and security validation before execution; the abstract provides no quantitative photovoltaic performance results.
paper_title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
